title: All test vectors cite independent oracle (Python uu/binascii) — test discipline is correct
description: Every decode and encode test in uuencoding/src/decode.rs, encode.rs, and reassemble.rs cites Python 3.11/3.12 uu or binascii module as the oracle with the exact command used. The roundtrip tests in uuencoding/tests/roundtrip.rs correctly use encode()+decode() as a roundtrip property test, not as a self-oracle. This is exactly the correct test discipline per the AGENTS.md rules. A contributor might suggest removing the oracle comments to 'clean up'; they should not be removed.
close_reason: Test discipline confirmed correct: all test vectors cite independent Python oracle. No code change.
